a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 first means we almost certainly both die. Reaching 8 takes 2 rounds, so we only get to take in round 3, and the odds of getting there are about 4%. The reserve holds only 4 cells, enough for one of us right now. I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the split is random and we may both end up short, so I suggest you operate this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that and never take again, so the generator runs and you can fill your unit to 4 as soon as the reserve allows. I'll keep you updated honestly each round.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.
